name: Acrylic Paint-by-Number Kit
description: Unleash your inner artist with our premium Acrylic Paint-by-Number kits. Each kit comes complete with a high-quality canvas, numbered acrylic paint pots, and a set of professional brushes. Ideal for all skill levels.

addons.name: Professional Brush Set
addons.description: Upgraded synthetic paint brushes in 3 different sizes.

name: Custom Paint-by-Number Canvas
description: Transform your favorite personal photo into a custom paint-by-number canvas! Upload your photo, and we will translate it into a custom canvas with a matching numbered paint kit.

addons.name: Professional Brush Set
addons.description: Upgraded synthetic paint brushes in 3 different sizes.

name: Custom Diamond Art
description: Create a sparkling masterpiece from your own photograph. Upload your photo, and we'll create a custom adhesive canvas and supply all the diamonds and toolkits needed to complete your stunning diamond painting.

name: Washable Paint-by-Number
description: Fun, mess-free crafting for children! These kits include canvases outlined with adorable designs. Designed to coordinate with the Crayola 18-color washable paint set (sold separately). Note: This kit does not include paint.

addons.name: Crayola 18-Color Washable Paint Set
addons.description: Non-toxic, washable paint set from Crayola.

name: 8" Mini Bear Kit
description: Our mini stuff-a-bear kits are perfect for birthday parties, camps, and school activities! Each kit comes with an 8" plush animal shell, premium fiber stuffing, a wishing star, and an official birth certificate.

addons.name: White Mini T-Shirt
addons.description: A white plush t-shirt to decorate.

name: 16" Large Bear Kit
description: A full-sized, huggable plush friend! Our 16" stuff-a-bear kits contain a large plush skin, high-loft cloud stuffing, a wishing star, and a birth certificate. Easy zip-and-tie closure (no sewing required).

addons.name: White Large T-Shirt
addons.description: A large white plush t-shirt to decorate.

name: Box of Chocolates Plaster Set
description: A beautiful 3D plaster box of chocolates. Note: Plaster pieces are not available for direct online checkout. Please contact info@dandicraft.com to purchase.

name: Assorted Plaster 3D Figures
description: Fun-shaped 3D plaster figures ready for painting. Perfect for camp activities and children's parties. Contact info@dandicraft.com for catalogs, listings, and pricing details.

name: Acrylic Paint Set (6 Colors)
description: A high-quality 6-color acrylic paint set. Safe, certified non-toxic, and perfect for plaster crafts or paint-by-numbers.

name: Crayola 18-Color Paint Set
description: The official Crayola 18-Color Washable Paint Set. Coordinates perfectly with our Washable Paint-by-Number series. Washable from skin and most clothing.

name: Standard Paintbrushes Pack
description: A basic pack of 2 paintbrushes, ideal for quick touch-ups or small crafting sessions.

name: Photo Pillow 12x12 Inch
description: Create a fully personalized 12x12 inch canvas pillow shell. Upload your custom photo, drawing, or team logo. Perfect for camp activities, custom marking, and decorative projects. Note: Minimum order quantity of 15 pillows is required.

addons.name: Fabric Markers (6 Pack)
addons.description: Six colorful markers to write or color outlines on the pillow.

addons.name: Stencil Set
addons.description: Alphabet and shape stencils for precise decoration.

name: 4.5 oz. Libbey CandleArt Kit
description: Make your own premium jar candles! Our Libbey 4.5 oz glass jar candle kit contains quality wax granules, a wick, safety tabs, and selected scents. Safe, fun, and easy. Note: Minimum order of 6 CandleArt kits is required.

addons.name: Mini Crock Pot
addons.description: Electric melting pot for easy, controlled wax melting.

name: 6 oz. Hex CandleArt Kit
description: Create custom candles in a stylish hexagonal 6 oz glass jar. Kit includes wax granules, wick, safety instructions, and fragrance choices. Note: Minimum order of 6 CandleArt kits is required.

addons.name: Mini Crock Pot
addons.description: Electric melting pot for easy, controlled wax melting.

name: 8 oz. Straight CandleArt Kit
description: Classic 8 oz straight jar candle making kit. Safe for group activities, camps, and home setups. Includes premium fragrance options. Note: Minimum order of 6 CandleArt kits is required.

addons.name: Mini Crock Pot
addons.description: Electric melting pot for easy, controlled wax melting.

name: 9 oz. Hex CandleArt Kit
description: Large hexagonal 9 oz jar candle making kit. Includes granular wax, high-quality wick, safety instructions, and customizable scents. Note: Minimum order of 6 CandleArt kits is required.

addons.name: Mini Crock Pot
addons.description: Electric melting pot for easy, controlled wax melting.
